title: Get Busy Living
html:
Your future belongs to you.

Not your family. Not your friends. Not the people around you who mean well but sometimes hold you back without knowing it. They can only decide their own future. Yours is yours alone.

And it all starts with how you think.

I am always reminded of The Shawshank Redemption. It is one of those films I keep coming back to. At its heart, it is a story about one thing: hope. The main character holds on when everyone else lets go. He refuses to stop believing in a better future, even when everything around him says it is impossible.

His philosophy was simple.

"Get busy living, or get busy dying."

That line has stayed with me for years. Because it is true. There is no neutral option. You are either moving toward something or drifting away from it.

The people around you will either inspire you or drain you. Be careful who you listen to. Seek out the ones who believe in what is possible. Avoid the people who have a reason why everything will not work. They are not protecting you. They are projecting their own limits onto you.

Challenges will come. They come for everyone. The storms are not the issue. The issue is how you respond.

That is where ENTHUSIASM comes in.

Not the forced kind. Not the stuff from a motivational book that wears off by Wednesday. Real enthusiasm comes from inside you. It grows when you have a clear picture of where you are going and why it matters. It builds when you stop waiting for someone else to fire you up.

Most motivational books fail because they make you dependent on them. True enthusiasm does not come from a page. It comes from purpose. And purpose is something only you can find.

Surround yourself with people who are going somewhere. People who encourage you and push you forward, not people who are comfortable standing still.

Get busy planning a great future. Start now.

This Week's Motivator

Decide that your future is your responsibility.

Choose one person this week who inspires you and spend more time with them.

Get busy living.

Prompt for the Week

Am I getting busy living, or am I drifting? What one decision this week would prove that I am moving forward?
